messages:
mica: Heads-up — planning a cutover to the albatross GPU pool autoscale/policy changes tonight at ~23:00 PT. Window 30m. Primary goals: apply new min_burst / slice eviction tweaks and validate steady-state latency under small load. Who can own smoke and who’s on rollback standby?

ben: I can run smoke. I’ll be ready at +5m after cutover to run quick checks.

kavya: I’ll be rollback owner. I have the rollback runbook ready and will coordinate with infra if we need to revert.

oliver: Quick config question — are we changing min_burst from 1 -> 2, and lowering slice_eviction_threshold to 0.6? Need to know exact bits so I can validate metrics.

mica: Yep — exact patch below. Primary change: min_burst: 2, eviction_threshold: 0.6, burst_window_ms: 2000. We’re keeping max_scale unchanged.

```
# snippet from policy v2
{
  "pool": "albatross",
  "min_burst": 2,
  "slice_eviction_threshold": 0.6,
  "burst_window_ms": 2000
}
```

ben: Got it. My smoke checklist (short):
- hit /health on 3 active endpoints
- sanity generation on small model (gpt-small) with 128 tokens -> expect < 1200ms p95
- run `/v1/pool-stats?pool=albatross` to check available GPUs and in-flight counts
- validate no new OOMs in last 5m via logs query

Examples I’ll run:
```
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health | jq .
curl -sS 'https://api.redwood.ai/internal/pool-stats?pool=albatross' | jq .active_gpus, .in_flight
# generation smoke
python tools/smoke_gen.py --model gpt-small --tokens 128 --endpoint https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

kavya: Rollback recipe (short):
1) Revert policy to v1 with tag `albatross-policy-v1` (Infra has the tag)
2) Force drain any suspicious nodes: `infractl node drain --pool albatross --reason policy-rollback`
3) Trigger warmup by priming 2 warm instances targeting the previous config
4) Notify oncall and users in #prod-alerts

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by mica: `albatross-policy-v2` planned at 1748882800. CI: green. Canary: 2 slices in staging passed.

oliver: One more ask — can we pin a tiny canary for 5m on production (10% traffic) before full flip? Even a brief canary would help verify latency SLOs.

mica: Agree. Plan: staged roll — canary 10% for 5m, if p95 latency delta <= +150ms and no OOM spikes then roll to 100% (remaining 90%). If either condition fails -> rollback.

ben: I’ll watch dashboards: latency p95, OOM count, queue_time, and cpu/gpu utilization. I’ll post results in this thread within 5-7m after canary.

kavya: I’ll stay oncall until 23:45 PT in case rollback is needed. Slack + phone available.

mica: Cool. Owners: deploy: mica, smoke: ben, rollback: kavya, validation: oliver.

ben: ACK — will post quick pass/fail with numbers. :thumbsup:

oliver: I’ll also capture a short flamegraph if p95 creeps up.

mica: Thanks — tagging SRE for awareness @deploy-bot and adding to the ops calendar. If anything changes ping here.

deploy-bot: reminder: please run the preflight smoke script 10m before scheduled deploy: `./scripts/preflight/albatross_preflight.sh`

ben: running preflight now. will report back in this thread.
